newsitem.title: RUSSIA: DeBakey says Yeltsin recovering well - Kremlin.
newsitem.headline: DeBakey says Yeltsin recovering well - Kremlin.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin has recovered from heart surgery even more rapidly than doctors had expected, Michael DeBakey, the leading U.S. cardiologist who was a consultant on the operation, was quoted as saying on Tuesday.
"The rehabilitation has proceeded even somewhat ahead of schedule, quicker than one would have expected by now," the Kremlin press office quoted DeBakey as saying.
"The post-operative period has gone favourably for the president, and Yeltsin is in good form," he said.
DeBakey, who met Yeltsin on Tuesday at Moscow's Central Clinical Hospital, advised a team of Russian surgeons who performed quintuple bypass surgery on Yeltsin on November 5.
A Kremlin spokesman could not say whether DeBakey gave the president a medical examination.
After a bad attack of pneumonia around New Year, Yeltsin has resumed a full work schedule in recent months and kept up an active public presence.
During their meeting on Tuesday, the president warmly thanked DeBakey for his consultations prior to the surgery, the Kremlin said. DeBakey is in Russia for a medical conference.
